rationale.conceptual: The task computes standard metrics (MARE, R², Spearman ρ) using pre-existing libraries (Open Babel, xtb, TorchANI) with no custom algorithm or deep method understanding needed. It is essentially a textbook application of off-the-shelf tools.
rationale.execution: The pipeline requires loading a public dataset, running three different computational chemistry packages on ~6,500 geometries, and performing per-molecule metric calculations followed by median aggregation. This involves multiple steps, tool installation, file-format handling, and looping over many molecules, making it a non-trivial multi-stage workflow.
